Landscape Design & Construction in the Blue Mountains

Full design-and-build landscaping for Blue Mountains homes — we plan it, we build it, and you get one accountable local team from first sketch to final planting.

A great Mountains garden starts with a plan that respects the block — the slope, the aspect, the soil and how you actually want to use the space. We design around all of it, then build it with our own crew.

From a simple courtyard to a full backyard transformation with levels, walls, paving and planting, we handle the lot and keep you updated the whole way.

What’s included

  • On-site consultation and concept design
  • Detailed plans, levels and plant selection
  • Earthworks, drainage and structural work
  • Paving, walls, steps and features
  • Planting, turf and finishing
  • One crew, one point of contact

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.
